name: Pokémon Red & Blue
notes: Base-game pack. Encounter pools generated from PokéAPI data, merged to location level across sub-areas, encounter methods, and the paired versions (in-game trades and raid/event distributions excluded); area order is estimated from encounter levels and is approximate. Species + levels only; moves/abilities/items intentionally left empty (Gen I has no abilities/held items). Champion Blue's team varies by the player's starter: this pack uses the variant where the player chose Bulbasaur, so Blue's starter is Charmander -> Charizard (Lv 65 ace), with Exeggutor Lv 61 and Gyarados Lv 63 completing the team. The other variants swap in Venusaur (player chose Charmander) or Blastoise (player chose Squirtle) as the Lv 65 ace. Champion levels cross-checked against the official Nintendo Power Player's Guide (Pidgeot 61 / Alakazam 59 / Rhydon 61 / variant pair 61+63 / starter 65).
